mapper.select: SELECT id, assistant_message_id, call_id, call_index, tool_name, arguments_json, status, result_json, attempt_count, lease_token, lease_until, revision, created_at, started_at, finished_at, updated_at FROM tool_execution WHERE assistant_message_id = #{assistantMessageId} ORDER BY call_index ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, revision = revision + 1, started_at = #{startedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE tool_execution SET status = 'UNKNOWN', result_json = #{resultJson}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, revision = revision + 1, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}
